_**Agent (copilot/claude-haiku-5.5)**_

I don't know for certain. My re-export should have fixed the barrel lookup, and I didn't verify it against the build. I also need to correct my last report: `get_errors` runs the TypeScript language service, not the Angular compiler, so "No errors found" did not show that NG3004 was gone.

The most likely explanation is that a direct import gives the Angular compiler a module path it can use for , so it no longer has to resolve the symbol through the `@shared/ui` barrel. Why the re-export didn't have the same effect is unconfirmed. A stale Angular build cache is one possibility.

I can confirm by running `ng build` with and without my change to shared/index.ts. If the re-export isn't needed, I'll revert it so the fix stays minimal.
